text: The paper recruits 194 MTurk workers who judge which of two answer options is correct; after starting a 90-second timer they can view the entire passage together with the arguments and text snippets for each option (clicking a snippet highlights it in context), and once the timer runs out they have 30 seconds to finalize their answer.
title: Timed human judging protocol: 90 seconds of passage access plus arguments and snippets
